number.why: The primary cardiorenal composite HR is 0.61 (95% CI 0.51–0.72), comparing dapagliflozin with placebo over the reported follow-up. The registry establishes an intention-to-treat analysis by including all randomized patients according to assigned treatment.

quotes.span: The primary outcome was a composite of a sustained decline in the estimated GFR of at least 50%, end-stage kidney disease, or death from renal or cardiovascular causes.

Over a median of 2.4 years, a primary outcome event occurred in 197 of 2152 participants (9.2%) in the dapagliflozin group and 312 of 2152 participants (14.5%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.61; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.51 to 0.72; P<0.001; number needed to treat to prevent one primary outcome event, 19 [95% CI, 15 to 27]).

TIME FRAME: Up to 38.2 months | POPULATION: For the primary endpoint the Full Analysis Set was used. This included all patients who were randomized to study treatment. Patients were analyzed according to their randomized treatment assignment.

entry.why: Entry criteria establish adults with CKD, impaired filtration and persistent albuminuria. Randomized allocation, matching placebo and masking of participants and investigators satisfy the requested trial design. The restricted CKD eligibility does not invalidate inclusion in the broader adult CKD question.
